title.zh: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源
title.en: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源

current_state.zh: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 已完成发布并开源权重：4280亿参数 MoE、Agent 成本降70%、社区许可含收入限制，DeepSWE v1.1 得分73.7%。
current_state.en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is fully released with open weights: 428B-parameter MoE, 70% lower agent-task cost, community license with revenue restrictions, and a 73.7% DeepSWE v1.1 score.

updates.title_zh: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源
updates.title_en: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源
updates.what_changed_zh: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash，确认其就是匿名“Space Bunny”模型，公布基准测试成绩（Automation-Bench 62.2%、DeepSWE 73.7%、BabyVision 91.0%），API定价为每百万输入token 0.15美元、输出0.60美元，并计划于10月23日开放权重。
updates.what_changed_en: MiniMax officially released M3.1 Flash, confirming it was the anonymous 'Space Bunny' model, publishing benchmarks (62.2% Automation-Bench, 73.7% DeepSWE, 91.0% BabyVision), setting API pricing at $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 output, and planning to open the weights on October 23.

updates.title_zh: MiniMax M3.1 Flash开源：4280亿参数，Agent任务成本降70%
updates.title_en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash开源：4280亿参数，Agent任务成本降70%
updates.what_changed_zh: MiniMax 于10月23日按计划开源 M3.1 Flash 权重，已上架 Hugging Face 和魔搭；披露模型为4280亿总参数 MoE（每次激活约230亿），采用稀疏注意力、量化训练与 DSpark 推测解码，Agent 任务成本较上代降70%、生成速度近3倍，权重采用 MiniMax Community License（年收入超2000万美元需书面授权）。
updates.what_changed_en: MiniMax released the open weights for M3.1 Flash on October 23 as planned, listed on Hugging Face and ModelScope; disclosed a 428B-total-parameter MoE (~23B active) with sparse attention, quantized training and DSpark speculative decoding, 70% lower agent-task cost and ~3x generation speed, under the MiniMax Community License (written authorization required above $20M annual revenue).
updates.current_state_zh: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 已完成发布并开源权重：4280亿参数 MoE、Agent 成本降70%、社区许可含收入限制，DeepSWE v1.1 得分73.7%。
updates.current_state_en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is fully released with open weights: 428B-parameter MoE, 70% lower agent-task cost, community license with revenue restrictions, and a 73.7% DeepSWE v1.1 score.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: MiniMax released open weights for M3.1 Flash, a 428B-parameter MoE model featuring sparse attention and speculative decoding that cuts agent-task costs by 70% and nearly triples generation speed, under a community license with revenue-based commercial restrictions.
updates.detailed_summary_en: MiniMax released open weights for M3.1 Flash, a 428B-parameter MoE model featuring sparse attention and speculative decoding that cuts agent-task costs by 70% and nearly triples generation speed, under a community license with revenue-based commercial restrictions.
